slides.texte_overlay:
Lessons men learn
from living abroad
You learn how small your problems are. Seeing how others live, work and struggle puts your own worries into perspective very quickly.
You learn to be comfortable alone. New city, no friends, no family. You discover you can build a life from nothing, and that confidence stays forever.
You learn that people are mostly kind. Strangers help you with directions, papers, a broken phone. Living abroad restores your faith in people.
You learn to laugh at your mistakes. Wrong word, wrong bus, wrong food. When you're new everywhere, being embarrassed stops being a big deal.
You learn to stay curious. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and it helps me understand every new place I live in.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. It helps me understand every new place I live in.

slides.texte_overlay: You learn the value of home. Your mother's cooking, your old friends, your language. Distance teaches you what really matters to you.
You learn to adapt fast. New rules, new food, new habits. A man who has lived abroad is rarely thrown off by change again. Nothing scares you as much.
